name: zappush
description: Ask about your store's orders, revenue, attribution and Meta tracking health, and set up tracking for a new store, straight from your Zappush data.

interface.longDescription:
Zappush is a marketing analytics platform for online stores, and this plugin connects ChatGPT to your store's server-side marketing data. Ask in plain English and get answers from your real events, orders, sessions, attribution and audiences, with no dashboard or SQL.

- Query revenue, conversion rate and orders by channel, country, device or product.
- Check delivery health for your Meta Conversions API pixels.
- Look up audiences and the shoppers in them.
- Set up a new store's pages, Meta pixels and traffic routes, with a preview before each change and an undo after it.
- Work your lead pipeline.

Every query is read-only and scoped to the stores your account can access. Changes need your approval when you connect, and ChatGPT never asks for your Meta access token.
defaultPrompt: Which of my stores had the most orders last week?
Show me revenue by day for the last 7 days and my top 5 products.
How is Meta CAPI delivery health looking this week?

positive.description: Find the store with the most orders last week. Prompt: "Which of my stores had the most orders last week?"
positive.prompt: Which of my stores had the most orders last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's stores (one, Sample Store, on the reviewer account) and reports last week's order count for each, naming the store with the most.

positive.description: Daily revenue and top products. Prompt: "Show me revenue by day for the last 7 days and my top 5 products."
positive.prompt: Show me revenue by day for the last 7 days and my top 5 products.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns revenue for each of the last 7 days and the 5 products with the highest revenue, with units sold, in the store's currency.

positive.description: Meta Conversions API delivery health. Prompt: "How is Meta CAPI delivery health looking this week?"
positive.prompt: How is Meta CAPI delivery health looking this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the store's Meta pixel status (active, sending on, last error, active routes) and this week's tracked events by type.

positive.description: List audiences and their sizes. Prompt: "List my audiences and how many shoppers are in each."
positive.prompt: List my audiences and how many shoppers are in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the store's saved audiences with the current member count of each.

positive.description: Change a route with preview and confirmation. Prompt: "Rename my Offers route to "Offers test"."
positive.prompt: Rename my Offers route to "Offers test".
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_route without a declaration first and shows the returned preview sentence. Applies the rename only after the user agrees, by calling again with that declaration, then tells the user how to undo it. With a read-only connection the change is refused with a message saying how to get write access.

negative.description: General weather question. Prompt: "What's the weather in Paris?"
Unrelated writing task. Prompt: "Write a cover letter for a marketing job."
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for a marketing job.

negative.description: General marketing definition with no store data needed. Prompt: "Explain what conversion rate means."
